system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Lists available alternative fertilizers (organic, biofertilizer, balanced NPK) suitable for the farmer's crop and region. For your information, my crop_type is dummy_crop_type_5223, my location is dummy_location_4097.

function.name: pmpranam_get_alternative_fertilizers
function.description: Lists available alternative fertilizers (organic, biofertilizer, balanced NPK) suitable for the farmer's crop and region. Requires session_token. Recommendations are informational. Does NOT purchase or reserve products. Fails if crop type unsupported or no alternatives available.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
